description:
[writes · `ads:budget` scope] Sets the brand's monthly and/or per-campaign activation caps, in cents (e.g. 50000 = $500). Needs the ads:budget scope; a cap above the owner's agent ceiling is an approval request, never applied. Guardrails: flayr enforces the owner's agent ceiling (per month, per campaign, per day) on the server; you cannot raise it. Inside it the change is applied at once; above it nothing changes and the result is `approval_requested` (HTTP 202) with `approvalUrl`, the owner's one-click approval link: give it to the user, and repeat the exact same call once the owner approves (the approval covers that call once). Every call is audited (Ads > Agent activity) and the owner gets a daily digest. Pass agentName and reason; both are shown to the owner.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/caps.)

agentName.description: Which agent is acting. Shown to the owner in Ads > Agent activity.

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

monthlyMaxMinor.description: Monthly activation cap, whole cents (100 to 10000000).

perCampaignMaxMinor.description: Per-campaign activation cap, whole cents (100 to 10000000).

reason.description: Why the agent is doing this. Shown to the owner and kept in the audit trail.

name: ads_caps_set
title: Set ad spend caps
